```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 7.2, fig.height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

Reproduces the Results section *Conventional Quality Checks* from the files written by `01_data_processing.Rmd`.

| Manuscript (Results, *Conventional Quality Checks*) | Section here | Output |
|---|---|---|
| *Exclusion Criteria*: **Table 1** | 2 | `outputs/tables/table1_qc_flags.csv` |
| *Exclusion Criteria*: the flagged online respondent; distance of AEA respondents to each threshold | 3 | `outputs/tables/exclusion_criteria_margins.csv` |
| *Visual Inspection*: **Figure 2** and its answer key (footnote) | 4 | `outputs/figures/fig2.pdf`, `outputs/tables/fig2_answer_key.csv` |
| *Visual Inspection*: statements about all 51 lab and 51 AEA respondents | 5 | `outputs/tables/visual_inspection_support.csv` |

Figure 1 (task schematic) is a drawing, not generated from data.

# Settings

```{r settings}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

ROOT     <- file.path("..")
PROC_DIR <- file.path(ROOT, "data", "processed")
TAB_DIR  <- file.path(ROOT, "outputs", "tables")
FIG_DIR  <- file.path(ROOT, "outputs", "figures")
walk(c(TAB_DIR, FIG_DIR), dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

SAMPLES   <- c("Lab", "Online", "AEA")
COND_COLS <- c(congruent = "#4575b4", neutral = "#9970ab", incongruent = "#d6604d")
SEED_FIG2 <- 80      # random draw of the ten respondents in Figure 2

show_table <- function(df, caption, digits = 3) {
  df |> kable(caption = caption, digits = digits) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
}
save_csv <- function(df, name) write_csv(df, file.path(TAB_DIR, paste0(name, ".csv")))

trials <- read_csv(file.path(PROC_DIR, "trials_all.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID), sample = factor(sample, levels = SAMPLES),
         congruency = factor(congruency, levels = c("congruent", "neutral", "incongruent")))
summ <- read_csv(file.path(PROC_DIR, "respondent_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID), sample = factor(sample, levels = SAMPLES))
qc <- read_csv(file.path(PROC_DIR, "respondent_qc.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID), sample = factor(sample, levels = SAMPLES))
stopifnot(nrow(summ) == 153, nrow(qc) == 153, nrow(trials) == 153 * 288)
```

# Table 1 (Results, *Exclusion Criteria*)

```{r table-1-quality-checks}
crit <- c(flag_accuracy      = "Task accuracy < .80",
          flag_fast_rt       = "Mean correct RT < 300 ms",
          flag_rt_3sd        = "Mean correct RT > 3 SD from sample mean",
          flag_no_congruency = "No congruency effect (incongruent <= congruent)",
          flag_missed        = "Misses > 10% of trials",
          flag_invariant     = "Fewer than four response keys used",
          flag_any           = "Flagged by any criterion")

table1 <- qc |>
  select(sample, all_of(names(crit))) |>
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "flag") |>
  group_by(flag, sample) |> summarise(n = sum(value), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = n) |>
  arrange(match(flag, names(crit)))
table1 |> mutate(flag = crit[flag]) |> show_table("Table 1")
save_csv(table1, "table1_qc_flags")
```

# Exclusion Criteria text (Results, *Exclusion Criteria*)

*"their lowest task accuracy was .92, their fastest mean correct response time was 584 ms, no AEA respondent had more
than 3 misses in 288 trials, and every AEA respondent showed a congruency effect of at least 113 ms"*; *"a single
respondent was flagged: its task accuracy was .65, and it had no correct response on incongruent trials"*.

```{r exclusion-criteria-margins}
margins <- qc |> group_by(sample) |>
  summarise(lowest_task_accuracy = min(accuracy), fastest_mean_correct_rt = min(mean_rt),
            most_misses = max(n_missed), smallest_congruency_effect = min(congruency_effect, na.rm = TRUE),
            largest_abs_rt_z = max(abs(rt_z)), fewest_keys = min(n_keys), .groups = "drop")
show_table(margins, "Most extreme value of each quality-check measure, by sample")
save_csv(margins, "exclusion_criteria_margins")

flagged <- qc |> filter(flag_any)
flagged_incongruent <- trials |> filter(ID %in% flagged$ID, congruency == "incongruent") |>
  summarise(incongruent_trials = n(), correct_responses = sum(rt_valid), misses = sum(missed))
show_table(bind_cols(flagged |> select(sample, accuracy, rt_incong), flagged_incongruent), "The flagged respondent")
```

# Figure 2 (Results, *Visual Inspection*)

Five lab and five AEA respondents are drawn at random (seed 80), shuffled and labeled P1 to P10.

```{r figure-2-visual-inspection, fig.height = 7.2}
set.seed(SEED_FIG2)
lab_ids   <- trials |> filter(sample == "Lab") |> distinct(ID) |> pull() |> sample(5)
aea_ids   <- trials |> filter(sample == "AEA") |> distinct(ID) |> pull() |> sample(5)
panel_ids <- sample(c(lab_ids, aea_ids))
panel_labels <- setNames(paste0("P", seq_along(panel_ids)), panel_ids)

quiz <- trials |> filter(ID %in% panel_ids) |> mutate(panel = factor(panel_labels[ID], levels = paste0("P", 1:10)))
rt_ok <- quiz |> filter(correct == 1, !missed)

kde_max <- rt_ok |> group_by(panel, congruency) |>
  summarise(peak = tryCatch(max(density(rt, from = 0, to = 2000, n = 400)$y), error = \(e) NA_real_),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  pull(peak) |> max(na.rm = TRUE)

acc_ann <- quiz |> group_by(panel, congruency) |>
  summarise(acc = mean(correct), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", acc * 100), row_idx = as.integer(congruency) - 1,
         x_sq = 1480, x_txt = 1560, y_pos = kde_max * (0.97 - row_idx * 0.15))

p_rt <- ggplot(rt_ok, aes(x = rt, fill = congruency, colour = congruency)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.65, bounds = c(0, 2000)) +
  geom_point(data = acc_ann, aes(x = x_sq, y = y_pos, colour = congruency),
             shape = 15, size = 2.8, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = acc_ann, aes(x = x_txt, y = y_pos, label = label, colour = congruency),
            size = 2.1, hjust = 0, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~panel, nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COND_COLS, name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = COND_COLS, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2000), breaks = c(0, 1000, 2000)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, kde_max * 1.06), labels = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Response time (ms)", y = "Density", tag = "a)") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 15, size = 3.5, alpha = 1)),
         colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 15, size = 3.5))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "right",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5), legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

effect_data <- rt_ok |> group_by(panel, congruency) |>
  summarise(mean_rt = mean(rt), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = congruency, values_from = mean_rt) |>
  mutate(congruency_effect = incongruent - congruent)

p_effect <- ggplot(effect_data, aes(x = congruency_effect, y = fct_rev(panel))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#8c8c8c", alpha = 0.90, width = 0.66) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#444444", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.02)) +
  labs(x = "Congruency effect (incongruent − congruent RT, ms)", y = NULL, tag = "b)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

fig2 <- (p_rt / p_effect) + plot_layout(heights = c(1.60, 0.65))
fig2
ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "fig2.pdf"), fig2, width = 7.2, height = 7.2, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "fig2.png"), fig2, width = 7.2, height = 7.2, dpi = 300)
```

## Figure 2 answer key (footnote)

```{r figure-2-answer-key}
fig2_key <- tibble(panel = paste0("P", 1:10), ID = panel_ids,
                   sample = if_else(panel_ids %in% aea_ids, "AEA", "Lab")) |>
  left_join(summ |> select(ID, accuracy, congruency_effect), by = "ID")
show_table(fig2_key, "Figure 2 answer key")
save_csv(fig2_key, "fig2_answer_key")

key_aea <- fig2_key$panel[fig2_key$sample == "AEA"]
key_lab <- fig2_key$panel[fig2_key$sample == "Lab"]
cat("AEA:", paste(key_aea, collapse = ", "), "| Lab:", paste(key_lab, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# Visual Inspection text (Results, *Visual Inspection*)

*"Both groups showed right-skewed response time distributions, high accuracy, and a positive congruency effect, and this
held for all 51 lab and all 51 AEA respondents. ... the AEA respondents had more skewed distributions and larger
congruency effects on average, mainly because of larger facilitation"* (Table S3).

```{r visual-inspection-support}
skew <- function(v) { v <- v[!is.na(v)]; mean((v - mean(v))^3) / sd(v)^3 * (length(v) / (length(v) - 1))^1.5 }
visual_support <- trials |> filter(rt_valid, sample %in% c("Lab", "AEA")) |>
  group_by(sample, ID) |> summarise(rt_skew = skew(rt), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(summ |> select(ID, accuracy, congruency_effect, facilitation, interference), by = "ID") |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  summarise(respondents = n(), right_skewed = sum(rt_skew > 0), mean_skew = mean(rt_skew),
            lowest_accuracy = min(accuracy), positive_congruency_effect = sum(congruency_effect > 0),
            mean_congruency_effect = mean(congruency_effect), mean_facilitation = mean(facilitation),
            mean_interference = mean(interference), .groups = "drop")
show_table(visual_support, "Visual Inspection statements, all lab and AEA respondents")
save_csv(visual_support, "visual_inspection_support")
```

# Checks

Numbers quoted in the Results; knitting stops if one has changed.

```{r checks}
m <- margins |> filter(sample == "AEA")
v <- visual_support |> column_to_rownames("sample")
stopifnot(
  identical(unname(unlist(table1[table1$flag == "flag_any", c("Lab", "Online", "AEA")])), c(0L, 1L, 0L)),
  identical(unname(unlist(table1[table1$flag == "flag_accuracy", c("Lab", "Online", "AEA")])), c(0L, 1L, 0L)),
  identical(unname(unlist(table1[table1$flag == "flag_no_congruency", c("Lab", "Online", "AEA")])), c(0L, 1L, 0L)),
  sprintf("%.2f", m$lowest_task_accuracy) == "0.92", round(m$fastest_mean_correct_rt) == 584,
  m$most_misses == 3, floor(m$smallest_congruency_effect) == 113,
  nrow(flagged) == 1, as.character(flagged$sample) == "Online", round(flagged$accuracy, 2) == .65,
  flagged_incongruent$correct_responses == 0,
  all(v$right_skewed == 51), all(v$positive_congruency_effect == 51),
  v["AEA", "mean_skew"] > v["Lab", "mean_skew"], v["AEA", "mean_congruency_effect"] > v["Lab", "mean_congruency_effect"],
  v["AEA", "mean_facilitation"] - v["Lab", "mean_facilitation"] > v["AEA", "mean_interference"] - v["Lab", "mean_interference"],
  length(key_aea) == 5, length(key_lab) == 5)
cat("All checks passed.\n")
sessionInfo()
```
